title: Table
summary: A data table. Two modes: hand it a raw table in the default slot (rows and cells exactly as authored) and it supplies the scroll frame, toolbar, bulk, empty and footer slots; or give it columns and rows and it renders the table itself, with sorting, filtering, selection, loading and phone cards. The data-driven mode: striped, hover, bordered, density, sticky header and first column, sortable headers, filter row, row selection with a bulk bar, loading and empty states and a card layout on a phone. Custom cell content goes in slots named cell-<rowId>-<key>. With manual set, the host owns sorting, filtering and paging and the element only renders and reports.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions: { key, label, type?: text|number|date, align?: start|end, sortable?, hidePhone? }[]. A JSON attribute or a property.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row data, one object per row. A JSON attribute or a property.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: The field that identifies a row.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternate row tint.

props.name: hover
props.description: Tint the row under the pointer.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Border on every cell.

props.name: density
props.description: Cell padding step.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Pin the header row (give the table a maxHeight).

props.name: stickyColumn
props.description: Pin the first column.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Checkbox column with select-all.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows are activatable: they show a pointer and fire pk-row-click.

props.name: filterable
props.description: A filter input under each header.

props.name: manual
props.description: The host sorts, filters and pages; rows are shown exactly as given.

props.name: sort
props.description: Key of the column being sorted.

props.name: sortDir
props.description: Sort direction.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filter text per column key: { [key]: text }.

props.name: selected
props.description: Ids of the selected rows.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows and mark the table busy.

props.name: cards
props.description: Each row becomes a card below 640px.

props.name: caption
props.description: Table caption.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrolling region.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Bounds the frame; sticky header and column need it.

props.name: flow
props.description: Slotted-table mode: no scroll frame, for a table inside a container that already scrolls.

slots.description: A raw table (thead, tbody, tfoot, any rows). The page-level layer styles it; the element frames it.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Search, filters and buttons above the table.

slots.name: bulk
slots.description: Actions shown while rows are selected.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Below the table; an pk-pagination fits.

events.name: pk-sort
events.description: A sortable header was activated. Cancel to keep the current sort.

cssProperties.name: --pk-table-max-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the scrolling frame (set from maxHeight).

a11y: A real table with a caption, aria-rowcount and aria-busy. Sortable headers hold a button and carry aria-sort. The scrolling frame is a labelled focusable region so the keyboard can scroll it. Checkboxes name their row; the selection count is a polite status. The card layout keeps the header for assistive technology. Cell values are set as text, never parsed as HTML.

blazor.notes: The Blazor PkTable keeps owning the data source. It renders the element with manual set, so the element does not sort, filter or page by itself: it reacts to pk-sort, pk-filter and the pk-page and pk-page-size events of the pagination in its footer by fetching the matching rows and assigning them to the rows property. Each column is passed in columns as { key, label, sortable, align: end } (align end for numeric columns); a hidden column is left out. Row template cells become slots named cell-<rowId>-<key>, one per cell. Without manual the element sorts, filters and pages its own rows. The Blazor EmptyText fills the empty slot.

examples.title: Sortable, selectable table
examples.html:
<pk-table id="t1" label="Products" caption="Stock by product" striped hover selectable
  columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU","sortable":true},{"key":"price","label":"Price","type":"number","sortable":true}]'
  rows='[{"id":1,"sku":"AC-001","price":"$4.99"},{"id":2,"sku":"AC-002","price":"$3.99"}]'>
  <pk-button slot="bulk" size="mini" variant="ghost">Archive</pk-button>
</pk-table>

examples.title: Empty and loading
examples.html:
<pk-table label="Empty" columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]' empty-text="No products yet"></pk-table>
<pk-table label="Loading" loading columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]'></pk-table>
